facts.fact: Mercedes Sosa was born on July 9, 1935, in San Miguel de Tucumán, Argentina.
Her birth name was Haydée Mercedes Sosa.
Sosa was a prominent singer and activist known for her contributions to folk and Nueva canción music.
She passed away on October 4, 2009, in Buenos Aires, Argentina, at the age of 74.
Mercedes Sosa was active in her music career from 1950 until her death in 2009.

sources.snippet:
Cantora, un Viaje Íntimo (English: Cantora, An Intimate Journey) is a double album by Argentine singer Mercedes Sosa, released on 2009 through Sony Music Argentina. The album features Cantora 1 and Cantora 2, the project is Sosa's final album before her death on October 4, 2009.

At the 10th Annual Latin Grammy Awards, Cantora 1 was nominated for Album of the Year and won Best Folk Album and Best Recording Package, the latter award went to Alejandro Ros, the art director of the album.
